tools.name: search_installers
tools.description: Find installers near a U.S. ZIP code or city, ranked by distance and fit exactly as the search at https://wiredhomepros.com/find/ ranks them (a member can get a small boost but never outranks a much closer, better-fitting installer). Pass spec (for example commercial-av or commercial-security) for t
